，来都来了（，来都来了（第22页）“灵石翻倍！”“下品灵器！”听到王登睦的承诺，众人原本低落下的情绪瞬间振奋了起来。“三少爷放心，”有人朗声道，“咱们在这域外战场混了那么多年也不是白给的，区区几只蜘蛛而已，还吓不到咱们，兄弟们说是不是？”“没错！”“说的是！”随着众人的回应，因为陨落一名修士而带来的阴霾也被一扫而空。看着重新振作起来的士气，王登睦呵呵一笑，向着众人拱了拱手，重新在青牛背上端坐了下来。想到刚刚这位三少主轻轻几句话便将众人的士气重新提了起来，现在又是一副如此举重若轻的模样，众人心中对这位王家三少主的纨绔印象顿时改观不少。“咔~咔咔~~”脚步行走在碎石上的声音传来，有人将神念探出防护光罩，面色顿时变了变。“有更多的红瞳蜘蛛过来了！”这人沉声提醒道，“其中还有十几头四足蜘蛛！”声音落下的同时，周围的人也都看到了红瞳蜘蛛那血一样嫣红的双目。“动手！”沉喝声传出，方才大显神威的金色剑光再次出现，径直向着其中一头四足的红瞳蜘蛛掠去。御剑的这名修士也是有着出窍境界的修为，心中忌惮四足红瞳蜘蛛方才显露出的实力，因此一出手便是动用了全力。金色剑光掠过，周围的黑烟都被向周围挤压了开来，显露出一条丈许长宽的通道来。“吱~~”尖锐的嘶鸣声传来，一道泛着红芒的蜘蛛向着金色剑光缠绕而来。无声无息间，最先靠近的蛛丝在金色剑光面前化为了青烟消失不见，然而不等御剑之人兴奋，更多的蛛丝从周围席卷而来，呼吸只间便将他的金色飞剑尽数缠绕在其中。“不好！”随着蛛丝越缠越多，这人明显感觉到自己与飞剑的心神联系变得迟缓了起来，“这蛛丝还能隔断修士与飞剑的心神联系，大家小心！”说话间，金色飞剑周围已经包裹了一团密密麻麻的蛛丝，从外面看去就像一团泛着红芒的蚕茧般。蚕茧内部，金色飞剑一开始还在挣扎，然而随着外面的蛛丝越缠越密，直至飞剑与驾驭者之间的心神联系被切断，飞剑才发出一道不甘的悲鸣，彻底沉寂了下来。“爆！”另一边，同样有修士的飞剑被蛛丝缠绕了起来，然而这修士倒也果决，直接引爆了飞剑内部的法阵。轰鸣声传出，灵力激荡之下，外面缠绕的蛛丝瞬间寸寸崩碎开来，磅礴的灵力波动向外席卷，将周围十几只红瞳蜘蛛向外逼退了十几丈距离，更有数十只脸盆大小的红瞳蜘蛛在这灵力波动横扫之下直接凌空爆碎了开来。

, it’s all coming (, it’s all coming (page 22) “Spiritual stones doubled!” “Low-grade spiritual weapons!” Hearing Wang Dengmu’s promise, everyone’s originally depressed mood instantly cheered up. “Don’t worry, Third Young Master,” someone said loudly, “We haven’t spent so many years in this foreign battlefield in vain. It’s just a few spiders, and they can’t scare us. Brothers, don’t you think so? "That's right!" "That's right!" With everyone's response, the haze caused by the death of a monk was swept away. Looking at the renewed morale, Wang Denmu smiled, bowed his hands to everyone, and sat down on Qingniu's back again. Thinking that the third young master had lifted everyone's morale again with just a few words. With such an effortless look, everyone's impression of the playboy of the third young master of the Wang family suddenly changed. "Ka~ka~~" came the sound of footsteps walking on the gravel, and someone's expression suddenly changed. "There are more red-eyed spiders coming!" The man reminded in a deep voice, "There are more than a dozen four-legged spiders among them!" At the same time, everyone around them also saw the blood-red eyes of the red-eyed spider. "Do it!" Shen shouted, and the golden sword light that had just shown its power appeared again, and it went straight towards one of the four-legged red-eyed spiders. The golden sword light passed by, and the surrounding black smoke was squeezed out, revealing a passage about ten feet long. "Squeak~~" A sharp neighing sound came, and a spider with a glow of red light entangled towards the golden sword light. Silently, the spider silk that was the first to approach turned into blue smoke and disappeared before the sword wielder was excited. A lot of spider silk swept from the surroundings, and his golden flying sword was entangled in it in just one breath. "No!" As the spider silk became more and more entangled, the man clearly felt that his mental connection with the flying sword had become slower. "This spider silk can also cut off the mental connection between the monk and the flying sword, everyone, be careful!" As he spoke, the golden flying sword was already wrapped in a dense mass. The spider silk looked like a ball of red silkworm cocoon. Inside the cocoon, the golden flying sword was still struggling at first. However, as the spider silk outside became more and more dense, until the mental connection between the flying sword and the driver was severed, the flying sword let out an unwilling cry and became completely silent. "Explode!" On the other side, the flying sword of the monk was also entangled in the spider silk. The monk was decisive and directly detonated the magic circle inside the flying sword. The roaring sound was heard, and under the surge of spiritual power, the spider silk wrapped around the outside instantly shattered. The majestic spiritual power wave swept outwards, forcing a dozen red-eyed spiders around him to retreat a dozen feet away. Dozens of red-eyed spiders the size of basins were directly exploded in the air under the sweep of this spiritual power wave.
